newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macquarie to issue ASX listed put warrants.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macquarie to issue ASX listed put warrants.

text.p: Macquarie Bank Ltd said on Thursday it would offer five put warrants over Australian Stock Exchange listed companies in a first for the Australian market.
Macquarie said the put warrants will cover shares in The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, WMC Ltd, National Australia Bank Ltd, Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Normandy Mining Ltd.
This is the first time put warrants have been admitted to trading status on ASX and it is in addition to the nine series of call warrants offered by Macquarie, it said.
Macquarie said the five new warrants will be offered from November 8 and are expected to be admitted to trading status on the ASX on November 12.
